description: IWLS95 orders the parts of a conjunctively partitioned transition relation. In *conjunctive partitioning*, an operator relation is a conjunction of small BDDs, and the image conjoins them one by one and removes (*quantifies*) each variable as soon as no later part mentions it. This *early quantification* keeps the intermediate BDDs small, but only with a good order. IWLS95 picks the next part by the weighted score `2·v/w + w/x + y/z + m/M`, which rewards parts that let many variables be quantified now and parts whose variables sit deep in the BDD variable order. Every order gives the same image; only the size of the intermediate BDDs changes.

papers.authors: R. K. Ranjan, A. Aziz, R. K. Brayton, B. Plessier, C. Pixley
papers.title: Efficient BDD algorithms for FSM synthesis and verification
